title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Ready-to-use interactive artifacts such as trackers and dashboards are now available for legal teams in a new legal gallery, with examples including a cite checker, matter board, and contract review. Partners contributing include Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner, and PwC, and 60+ legal connectors have been added since May. Artifacts can be shared with privacy and ethical-wall settings, and a Legal Ambassadors Program has launched with a waitlist open.

title: How to manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
summary: This best-practices guide covers controlling, tracking, and proving the value of Claude Code spend on Google Cloud. The Claude apps gateway in your Google Cloud project adds per-user, per-group, and per-org spend caps, model allowlists, in-CLI warnings at 75% and 95%, and an admin API, while Claude Code OpenTelemetry data now breaks down usage by skill, plugin, agent, and MCP server. The guide argues cost per task matters more than price per token and suggests pairing usage data with surveys and metrics like PR cycle time.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Claude Duet is a research-preview agent that runs on a cloud computer with your connected apps and continues working after the app is closed. Important actions such as sending, paying, or deleting require approval, and a new classifier screens outgoing messages for sensitive information in "never share" and "needs consent" tiers. The agent never sees passwords, cookies, or tokens, which are handled by a separate browser machine and outside proxy, and approval frequency and classifier accuracy are still being tuned during the preview.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors is a plugin of connectors and workflow skills for advisors, connecting to custodians such as Schwab, portfolio platforms such as Addepar and SS&C Black Diamond, and CRMs such as Wealthbox. Skills cover pre-meeting prep, follow-ups, rebalance reviews, and compliance checks, and Claude stages client communications and CRM updates for advisor approval. It is available via Enterprise plans, where audit logs can support RIA recordkeeping.

title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, working with Theorem, used Claude to write formal proofs, checked with the Rocq proof checker, that compiled open-source code cannot crash. The work covered 239 entry points across 123 open-source libraries with inputs up to 64 MB, and found bugs that were patched, suggesting verification could become practical for far more software. The team cautions that the proofs rely on trusted components, so "formally verified" does not mean bug-free.

title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
summary: Three Claude Enterprise features are now generally available: smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets. Smart reports sample transcripts and group workstreams to show spend, deliverables, and friction points, but are not meant for individual performance review. Pooled budgets add a shared monthly budget with alerts at 50/75/95/100%, individual limits still apply, and availability varies by configuration.
